svg.title: coverage ndsdd original
svg.desc: Coverage of Non-Deterministic Spec-Driven Development, original edition. A conceptual route moves through specification, plan, tasks and implementation. The GitHub Spec Kit focus is supported by templates, worked examples and playbooks, with integration, advanced patterns and professional judgment.
svg.text: ORIGINAL EDITION / FROM PRINCIPLES TO PRACTICE
A practical companion for turning a specification into working software.
GITHUB SPEC KIT / A CONCEPTUAL WORK ROUTE
Connect the toolkit to a project
